In contrast to step5b, here we first select T cells using gene expression signatures, and then make prediction by their TCRs.

```{r load_libraries, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpointdensity)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(pROC)
library(ROCR)
library(ggrepel)
theme_set(theme_classic())

data_dir   = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_processed_data"
result_dir = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_results"
CAT_dir  = "~/research/CAT/data"

pcut_A = as.numeric(params$pcut_A)
pcut_B = as.numeric(params$pcut_B)

pcut_A
pcut_B
```

# Read in data

## Read in cell information of Zheng et al. data
```{r message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cd8 = fread(file.path(CAT_dir, "CD8_CAT_final.tsv"))
cd4 = fread(file.path(CAT_dir, "CD4_CAT_final.tsv"))

cd8 = cd8[study == "Zheng_2021",]
cd4 = cd4[study == "Zheng_2021",]

cd8[, library_id := paste(cancer_type, Sample, "T", sep = "-")]
cd4[, library_id := paste(cancer_type, Sample, "T", sep = "-")]

dim(cd8)
dim(cd4)

cd8[1:2,]
cd4[1:2,]

```

## Read mutation and TCR data

Here we only consider the TCRs with positive score > 0 and negative score < 0, and they are TCRs of CD8 T cells. 

```{r fig.width=5, fig.height=3}
mut_dat = fread("../data/mut_dat_matrix.tsv")
dim(mut_dat)
mut_dat[1:2,1:3]

mut_mat = data.matrix(mut_dat[,-1])
rownames(mut_mat) = mut_dat$mutation

TCR_A = fread("../data/TCR_alpha_dat_matrix.tsv")
dim(TCR_A)
TCR_A[1:2,1:3]

TA_mat = data.matrix(TCR_A[,-1])
rownames(TA_mat) = TCR_A$TCR

TCR_B = fread("../data/TCR_beta_dat_matrix.tsv")
dim(TCR_B)
TCR_B[1:2,1:3]

TB_mat = data.matrix(TCR_B[,-1])
rownames(TB_mat) = TCR_B$TCR

stopifnot(all(names(mut_dat)[-1] == names(TCR_A)[-1]))
stopifnot(all(names(mut_dat)[-1] == names(TCR_B)[-1]))
```


# Check prediction by TCR

## Load prediction model

```{r}
fnm = sprintf("TCGA_res_TCR_predictors_pval_pA_%.1e_pB_%.1e.rds", pcut_A, pcut_B)
TCR_pred = readRDS(file = file.path(result_dir, fnm))
length(TCR_pred)
names(TCR_pred)[1:5]
```

# Make prediction for each somatic mutation

Since this is scRNA-seq data, one TCR may appear in many cells. We can count somatic- mutation-related TCRs across all cells. 


## Construction prediction matrics

```{r}
table(mut_dat$mutation %in% names(TCR_pred))
all_muts = intersect(mut_dat$mutation, names(TCR_pred))
length(all_muts)

mut_mat = mut_mat[match(all_muts, rownames(mut_mat)),]
dim(mut_mat)

pred_mtx_A =  matrix(0, nrow=length(all_muts), ncol=ncol(mut_mat))
rownames(pred_mtx_A) = all_muts
colnames(pred_mtx_A) = colnames(mut_mat)

pred_mtx_sc = pred_mtx_A
pred_mtx_B  = pred_mtx_A

for(i in 1:length(all_muts)){
  mut_i = all_muts[i]
  prd_i = TCR_pred[[mut_i]]
  stopifnot(length(prd_i) > 0)
  
  if(length(prd_i$TCRA) > 0){
    wi = which(rownames(TA_mat) %in% prd_i$TCRA)
    if(length(wi) > 0){
      pred_mtx_A[i,] = colSums(TA_mat[wi,,drop=FALSE]>0)
    }
  }
  
  if(length(prd_i$TCRB) > 0){
    wi = which(rownames(TB_mat) %in% prd_i$TCRB)
    if(length(wi) > 0){
      pred_mtx_B[i,] = colSums(TB_mat[wi,,drop=FALSE]>0)
    }
  }
  
  if(length(prd_i$TCRA) > 0 && length(prd_i$TCRB) > 0){
    
    wi_CD8 = which(cd8$TRA_cdr3 %in% prd_i$TCRA & cd8$TRB_cdr3 %in% prd_i$TCRB)
    wi_CD4 = which(cd4$TRA_cdr3 %in% prd_i$TCRA & cd4$TRB_cdr3 %in% prd_i$TCRB)
    
    wi = union(wi_CD8, wi_CD4)
    
    if(length(wi) == 0){ next }
    
    tbi = table(tcr$Sample[wi])
    ntcell = rep(0, ncol(pred_mtx_sc))
    mati   = match(names(tbi), colnames(pred_mtx_sc))
    stopifnot(sum(is.na(mati)) == 0)
    ntcell[mati] = tbi
    pred_mtx_sc[i,] = ntcell
  }
}

dim(pred_mtx_A)
dim(pred_mtx_B)
dim(pred_mtx_sc)

summary(rowSums(pred_mtx_A > 0))
summary(rowSums(pred_mtx_B > 0))
summary(rowSums(pred_mtx_sc > 0))
```


## Evaluate prediction for each mutation

Most mutation only occur once and thus the evaluation will not be very accurate for those mutations. 

```{r fig.width=3, fig.height = 3}
table(rowSums(mut_mat))

# for scTCR data, the read-depth are the same for alpha nad beta chains
summary(colSums(TA_mat))
summary(colSums(TB_mat))

auc_mat = matrix(nrow=nrow(mut_mat), ncol=4)

for(i in 1:nrow(mut_mat)){
  y_i = mut_mat[i,]
  x_A = pred_mtx_A[i,]
  x_B = pred_mtx_B[i,]
  x_cell = pred_mtx_sc[i,]
  x_AB = x_A + x_B
  table(x_AB, y_i)
  
  auc_mat[i, 1] = auc(y_i, x_A, quiet=TRUE, direction="<")
  auc_mat[i, 2] = auc(y_i, x_B, quiet=TRUE, direction="<")
  auc_mat[i, 3] = auc(y_i, x_AB, quiet=TRUE, direction="<")
  auc_mat[i, 4] = auc(y_i, x_cell, quiet=TRUE, direction="<")
}

colnames(auc_mat) = c("AUC_alpha", "AUC_beta", "AUC_both", "AUC_cell") 

auc_df = data.frame(mutation = rownames(mut_mat), 
                    mut_freq = rowSums(mut_mat))

auc_df = cbind(auc_df, round(auc_mat,2))
auc_df = auc_df[order(auc_df$AUC_both, decreasing = TRUE),]
rownames(auc_df) = NULL

auc_df = auc_df[order(auc_df$mut_freq, decreasing = TRUE),]
dim(auc_df)
auc_df[auc_df$mut_freq > 1,]
```
